decisions.name: checkpointed_layers
decisions.label: checkpoint
decisions.reason: one layer for the largest of the 30 micro-batches this job trains, 3,868 tokens (8 examples, end to end); the data's 8 longest would be 7,569: 0.47 GiB keeping everything, 0.03 recomputed whole; its forward and backward 77 / 103 ms in that order; free: 84 of 122 GiB; selective recomputation not offered: the layers are compiled, and the policy does not reach inside a compiled region

decisions.name: selective_layers
decisions.label: selective
decisions.reason: the layers are compiled, and the policy does not reach inside a compiled region

decisions.name: effective_batch
decisions.label: batch
decisions.reason: 7.9B parameters, up to 13B: the smallest that keeps the GPU busy: LoRA learns less from large batches (Thinking Machines, 2025); QLoRA used 16 up to 13B and 32 to 64 above (Dettmers et al., 2023, table 9); batched by examples; Recipe(tokens_per_update='auto') batches by tokens instead

decisions.name: micro_batch
decisions.label: micro-batch
decisions.reason: the largest share of 8 examples that fits with every layer checkpointed: 1.57 GiB for the largest of the 30 micro-batches this job trains, 3,868 tokens (8 examples, end to end); the data's 8 longest would be 7,569
